title: Add a Table
objective: Learn how to define and access a table and its data.

exercise.instructions:
1. Add 'add_cfe_tables(@template@ fsw/tables/@template@_tbl.c)' so the table source file is included in the build.

fsw/tables/@template@_tbl.c was in the original but not included in the build

1. Locate the ExampleParamCmd definition in the '<DataTypeSet>' element. After this definiton, insert a new ExampleTable ContainerDataType definition as shown in the exercise window.

Note the GUI needs to be restarted after building this lesson's cFS target.
Refer to the Tutorial Document for more information.

1. Locate the '<RequiredInterfaceSet>' element and insert a new ExampleTable Interface definition as shown in the exercise window.

Note the GUI needs to be restarted after building this lesson's cFS target.
Refer to the Tutorial Document for more information.
1. Add the DEFAULT_@TEMPLATE@_PLATFORM_TABLE_FILE macro definition from the exercise window to define the table source filename.
1. Add the DEFAULT_@TEMPLATE@_PLATFORM_TABLE_FILE macro definitions from the exercise window to define the table source filename.

1. Add the code from the exercise window that includes the default table values and an invocation of the CFE_TBL_FILEDEF() macro to supply information to the table creation tool.

Note see the block comment above the macros for limitations imposed by the CFE_TBL_FILEDEF() macro.

1. In the header includes section add
    #include "@template@_tbl.h"

1. Locate the @TEMPLATE@_Init() fucntion. At the end of the
function before the initialization complete event message, add the code from the exercise window.

1. Locate the @TEMPLATE@_NoopCmd() function and insert the highlighted code as shown in the exercise window.

Note this code is added to the Noop function for convenience so the table alues can be displayed with minal code changes.
